tts_requests.text: Hi, I'm EMMI, your ITERA Care Assistant. Dr. Fresner Lee's care team invited you; your doctor remains part of your care. ACCESS is a Medicare option for extra support between doctor visits, not to replace your doctors. Taking part is your choice. When you're ready, choose 'Start your care journey.'

First, we need to know who is filling this out today. That lets us set the rest up correctly for you. If someone is helping you, you still make the decisions about your care. Choose the option that describes you: yourself, someone helping you, or an authorized personal representative.
